lines.en: The children look so alike, don't you think?
Yes, their faces are very similar.
But their tastes differ a lot.
Really? What does the younger one like?
Unlike his brother, he loves soup.
I see. Did they eat well last night?
Yes. Last night he ate a whole bowl.
lines.ko: 네. 어젯밤에 동생이 한 그릇을 다 먹었어요.

lines.en: Wonderful. Should I bring fruit or cake tomorrow?
lines.ko: 좋네요. 내일 과일을 가져갈까요, 케이크를 가져갈까요?

lines.en: Either one is fine. They love both.
lines.ko: 둘 중 아무거나 좋아요. 둘 다 잘 먹어요.

lines.en: Thank you. Then I will bring both.

dialogs.about: 가게에서 점원과 목도리 두 개를 견주어 봐요

lines.en: Hello! May I help you?
Yes, please. I want a warm scarf.
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 따뜻한 목도리를 사고 싶어요.

lines.en: These two are very similar.
How do they differ?
Unlike the blue one, this one is softer.
lines.ko: 파란 것과 달리 이게 더 부드러워요.

lines.en: I bought one like this last winter.
Oh! Was it warm enough?
Very warm. My daughter still wears it.
lines.ko: 아주 따뜻했어요. 딸이 아직도 매고 다녀요.

lines.en: Neither one is heavy. Please take the one you like.
lines.ko: 둘 다 무겁지 않아요. 마음에 드는 걸로 하세요.

lines.en: Either is fine. I will take the soft one.
lines.ko: 둘 다 좋네요. 부드러운 걸로 할게요.
